rootCause: Calculator skipped entry activation, so held mutation berries were not active on isolated copies. Classic damage equipment already used the native pipeline.
fix: Shared native entry-item helper on disposable attacker/defender copies; no entry abilities or hazards replayed. HP percentages and notes reflect activated berries. Readable held item names in UI.

berryCoverage.formatScope: Singles engine shared by Adventure, arenas, PvP, collaborative singles, Tour and Draft; no separate battle formula added. Simulator doubles/raids tested independently; not a claim of all format UIs played end-to-end.
